Models were trained on 10,000 compounds sampled from each pool, so that conditions differed in chemical coverage but not in training-set size.

For predictive evaluation, training sets of 50,000, 70,000 and 100,000 compounds were sampled from the X-free training pools of JARVIS, MP and OQMD, respectively, and models were evaluated on the X-present target compounds in each interval.
